## Où j'en suis
Built a 3-hour SRE take-home exercise (compose with flaky-svc, Prometheus broken alert rule, connection leak, over-broad Terraform IAM policy, no Kubernetes) and a 4-area rubric scored 0–3 with no cut-off. Exercise lives in new private repo kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home (subtree-pushed, only exercise commits); hiring/ removed from the infra branch working tree, not committed, no PR opened.

- [prochaine-étape] Thursday 4pm Tel Aviv call, then Maya sends the exercise herself and adds the collaborator invite (agent must not email anyone)
- [décision] No Kubernetes, 3-hour max, Terraform + compose only (source: t03)
- [décision] compose builds flaky-svc from source, no prebuilt image (source: t06)
- [décision] Rubric has no pass threshold; scores feed the panel (Maya + Noa), Noa is second reviewer (source: t10)
- [décision] Exercise moved to its own private repo, not infra, to keep candidate history clean (source: t12)
- [décision] Delete hiring/ from the infra branch, no PR in infra (source: t14)
- [essai-raté] Multi-arch build with `docker buildx --load` fails (manifest lists unsupported); compose up also failed on the amd64-only image on Apple Silicon
